source.terms: Criteo official terms apply CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and limit licensed use to noncommercial purposes with attribution and share-alike conditions.

dataset.samplingRule: all physical rows from the pinned day=2015-02-15 part-00079 parquet shard; no label-conditioned sampling

split.semantics: fixed contiguous source-order blocks; parquet conversion order was not independently audited and is not claimed chronological

training.selection: minimum dev LogLoss checkpoint only; test never selects epochs or hyperparameters

lr.implementation: sparse first-order categorical embeddings plus numeric linear terms

limitations: This run uses every row in one pinned official parquet shard, not the complete 1TB or 24-day corpus.
The parquet conversion order was not independently audited, so source-order blocks are not described as chronological.
Criteo states positive and negative examples were subsampled at different rates; raw probabilities are not population CTR without correction.
Hashed categorical feature semantics are undisclosed.
Offline public-data metrics do not establish online CTR lift, revenue lift, or KAI production performance.
CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 restricts use to noncommercial research under its terms.
